pages.text: The veteran brute has returned, now rotting but still strong enough to weather powerful blows as though they were made of paper.
The zombie can be healed by feeding it Rotten Flesh or wearing Necro Cape, though the latter case takes far longer to passively heal than most other undead servants.
Baby Zombie Servants can ride upon these brutes by commanding them towards them. When at or below half their max health, the brute will throw their rider towards their foe.
